segments.title: Cold Open: Pepito Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the official top-of-hour broadcast sign-on as executive producer, identifying as the dog who produces the show.

segments.title: David Lynch Tribute & Louis C.K. Clip
segments.notes: Case discusses David Lynch's death, transcendental meditation, and plays a clip from Louis C.K.'s show featuring Lynch as a comedic talk show host.

segments.title: Supreme Court Upholds TikTok Ban
segments.notes: Case and Sammy cover the unanimous Supreme Court decision upholding the TikTok ban on national security grounds, Trump's potential lifeline, and the impact on small businesses and creators.

segments.title: Elon Musk Path of Exile 2 Controversy
segments.notes: Case, Sammy, and Peter react to Asmongold and gaming creators exposing Elon Musk's allegedly boosted/faked high-level Hardcore character, watching Crip and Quin breakdowns.

segments.title: Peter Gibbon Wall Update
segments.notes: Peter reports from the crawlspace: he has sprayed the walls, claims the 200 rats are now poison-resistant and he is their general.

segments.title: Hype Train Derailment & Community Subs
segments.notes: Hype Train triggers on community subs from Tam (10 months), delivers freestyle raps, declares himself a 'cosmic baby train', and interacts with Kendall.

segments.title: Nintendo Switch 2 Trailer Reaction
segments.notes: Trint and Chris (At the Movies) react to the Switch 2 reveal: larger screen, same dock, backward compatibility; Case compares it to Wii U and PSP.

segments.title: Bubble Ghost Remake Trailer
segments.notes: Case discovers a recent Bubble Ghost remake trailer, watches it, and debates original vs. remake aesthetics with Trint/Chris.

segments.title: Queen of the Ring Trailer
segments.notes: Wrestling biopic trailer (March 7 release) featuring Mildred Burke, Billy Corgan, and Vince McMahon; Case notes brief wrestler cameos.

segments.title: Paradise (Hulu Series) Trailer
segments.notes: Political thriller series trailer: president dies, investigation, non-linear timeline; Case critiques bisexual/non-linear filmmaking.

segments.title: Presidential Hotness Ranking
segments.notes: Case ranks all U.S. presidents by hotness: Grant, Hayes, young Biden, Obama, JFK (dethroned), Taft (John Goodman comparison), Wilson (latex vibe).

segments.title: First Ladies Hotness Ranking
segments.notes: Case ranks first ladies: Dolly Madison, Julia Tyler, Sarah Polk, Margaret Taylor, Jackie Kennedy (nicest lady), young Hillary (conflicted), Michelle Obama (arms), Melania (ice lady).

segments.title: How To: Beard Trimmer, Scissors, Manly Voice & ED Expert
segments.notes: Jeb and Jeb's Dad (stuck in wood) present beard trimming tutorials (trimmer guards, scissors technique) and a 'manly voice' instructional; ends with prostate cancer survivor Michael Russer discussing impotence.

segments.title: Dad with 14 Kids Advice Segment
segments.notes: A caller claiming to be a famous dad (Homer Simpson bit) gives terrible parenting advice: ignore kids, choke them, rap over Bart Simpson trap beat.

segments.title: Sign-Off & Spinachi
segments.notes: Case reads Spinachi chat, confirms M/W/F schedule, Pepito claims chemical workout gains and mysterious bulges, broadcast ends.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covers the Supreme Court's unanimous TikTok ban upheld on national security grounds with Trump equivocating on a lifeline, then pivots to the Elon Musk Path of Exile 2 scandal where gaming creators expose his allegedly boosted Hardcore character. The broadcast features a David Lynch tribute, Nintendo Switch 2 and Bubble Ghost remake trailer reactions, a presidential hotness ranking (Grant and Hayes top, JFK dethroned), first ladies ranking (Jackie Kennedy 'nicest lady'), a How To with Jeb on beard grooming and manly voice cultivation, and a Homer Simpson bit as a 'dad with 14 kids.' Pepito manages sub goals for a Christen/Trint game stream while Peter Gibbon reports poison-resistant rats in the walls.
